generated_by: World stocks panels, Phase 1 + Phase 2 (benchmarks, persistence baseline, forecast records) + Phase 3 scenarios v2026-09-17; corridor-lapses extended to Dec 2027 as conditional version v2026-09-18 (fixed-total-disruption reading, P2+C0). See research/world-stocks-research.md and research/stress-test/.

conventions.sign: positive = stocks increased; negative = stocks decreased

status.reported: a direct observation published by the source (filled marker)
status.reported_preliminary: published, but the source flags the underlying data as preliminary (hollow marker, flagged in tooltip)
status.derived: published value computed by the source from forecast inputs, e.g. days of forward demand using forecast demand (hollow marker, flagged in tooltip)
status.agency-projection: a projection published by a source agency, stated as such (thin gray dashed line, hollow markers — never styled more prominently than reported values)
status.model-projection: a projection produced by the site's own model (not yet in use; Phase 3)

conventions.missing: missing periods are absent or explicit null — never interpolated; lines do not span unobserved periods
conventions.vintages: the IEA revises values between OMR editions; each point names the edition it came from; tooltips show the edition date

query.note: api_key parameter required but deliberately omitted here. Reproducible without a key via the EIA's 'international' dataset (Stocks, OECD).

eia_steo_world_inv_change_mb.name: World oil inventory change implied by EIA STEO production minus consumption (Sep 2026–Dec 2027)

query.source: EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook, released 9 Sep 2026 (workbook generated 3 Sep 2026)
query.sheet: Table 3a (3atab): World Total, crude oil and other liquids
query.rule: monthly change = (World Production − World Consumption) x calendar days in month, from STEO Table 3a (series papr_world / patc_world, mb/d), at full workbook precision — intermediate values are NOT rounded; rounding happens only for display. Sign convention verified: EIA's published t3_stchange_world row equals the exact negation of (Production − Consumption) to <1e-8 mb/d for all 16 months.
query.horizon: Sep 2026 – Dec 2027: the full published forecast horizon of this STEO edition for Table 3a; not extended

forecast_records.validity_note: 2027-12 — Extended (v2026-09-18) under the fixed-total-disruption persistence reading: the assumed total Gulf shut-in is held at 16.217 mb/d (13.5 scenario increment + 2.717, the EIA's published 1Q27 average baseline shut-in), so the production adjustment equals the assumed baseline shut-in minus 16.217 (−13.5 while it is 2.717, Mar–Jun 2027; −16.217 once it is 0, Jul–Dec 2027); demand stays −5 mb/d below the EIA baseline (the scenario's existing H1-2027 convention, carried flat). The post-1Q27 baseline shut-in schedule (2.717 through Jun 2027, 0 from Jul) is a stated test simplification, not a source-derived schedule. The Sep 2026 – Feb 2027 targets are verbatim from the issued v2026-09-17 record, whose assumptions were carried only to February 2027. The Mar 2027 – Dec 2027 extension is conditional — an 'if the closure persists' path, not a central forecast; the range across the other persistence readings (research page) is a spread of assumptions, not a confidence interval.
